description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_InterchangeBuilder, which constructs and manages interchange objects for HTMLPurifier configuration schemas, including methods for building from directories, handling namespaces and directives, and parsing configuration data.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_InterchangeBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating and populating HTMLPurifier configuration interchange objects from directory data and hashes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the varParser, defaulting to HTMLPurifier_VarParser_Native if none provided.

methods.name: buildFromDirectory
methods.description: Builds an interchange object by reading configuration files from a specified directory.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds an interchange object based on a provided hash, determining whether it's a namespace or directive.

methods.name: buildNamespace
methods.description: Creates and adds a namespace to the interchange object based on hash data.

methods.name: buildDirective
methods.description: Creates and adds a directive to the interchange object based on hash data.

methods.name: evalArray
methods.description: Evaluates a string of PHP array code without the array() wrapper.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Converts an array list into a lookup array with true values.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Creates an ID object from a string ID.

methods.name: _findUnused
methods.description: Checks for unused keys in the hash and triggers warnings for them.
